articles.title: Lady Frost eyes Major League Wrestling women's title, touts 'incredible roster'
articles.summary: Lady Frost declared herself the top contender for Shotzi's MLW Women's World Championship and says she'll do whatever it takes to claim the gold.
articles.body: Lady Frost has her eyes on the Major League Wrestling (MLW) Women’s World Championship and is willing to do whatever it takes get some gold wrapped around her waist. Shotzi found herself a challenger in Lady Frost over the last few weeks after she rose in MLW to grab the title from Shoko Nakajima on MLW "Fusion" back in June. Frost came out to confront Shotzi on last week’s episode, appearing to declare herself the top contender for the belt. I have everything to prove and that's the No. 1 spot and I deserve it. That's it. It's as simple as that," Lady Frost told OutKick Dropkick in a recent interview. Frost said she would give "everything" to get that championship. "Literally everything. That's the goal," she said. "And I'm willing to do whatever it takes to get it." Frost was one of MLW’s marquee signings this year to bolster its women’s division. She shared some light on why she decided to sign with MLW back in April. "So, the conversation that we had was very valuable to me because they've been watching me for a very long time, not just my work in the past few years," she said. "And I think it's important for someone to believe in you creatively and as a performer in general. And I think they have all the confidence in the world in me. And that's exactly what I wanted to hear. MLW also has alliances with Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and Stardom, which allows for the roster to mix it up with opponents from around the world. Frost said those relationships were a part of the intrigue. "I think I've done numerous tours in CMLL and that's a great fit for me. And then the girls of Stardom, obviously those are great matches," she said. "I love working those girls. And then there's the independents, which I feel like was very healthy for me to get back into creatively. "It's not all about hitting your times and being on camera and doing things appropriately. It's reminding ourselves why we do this and what we're fighting for, and most times it's the fans, right? So, having a little bit of everything right now while focusing on that title for MLW has really been great for my career." Frost is set to take on Corinne Joy at MLW’s Kings of Colosseum event. articles.title: Major disruption as grass fire hits Heathrow train links
articles.summary: Severe delays and cancellations are set to continue, with no trains between central London and the airport.
articles.body:
Trains to and from Heathrow Airport have been halted after a trackside grass fire caused delays and cancellations.

National Rail said "major disruption" was expected until the end of Saturday following the incident which began shortly after 16:00 BST.

A statement said all lines were blocked between London Paddington station and Heathrow's terminals, as well as Reading, due to "a failure of the electricity supply caused by a fire next to the track".

An update from Network Rail Western late on Saturday said the fire had been extinguished, but warned that disruption would continue, possibly into Sunday morning for some services.

It comes hours after a separate grass fire on Heathrow's airfield shut a runway earlier on Saturday.

Pictures on social media showed crowds of stranded passengers at Paddington, one of London's main rail hubs.

London Fire Brigade said six fire engines and around 40 crew members were tackling the blaze near Scrubs Lane, North Kensington.

Great Western Railway cancelled its services to Reading and no Elizabeth line or Heathrow Express services were running between Paddington and Heathrow on Saturday night.

The airport advised passengers to leave extra time for their journeys, adding that the Piccadilly line, which runs services to the airport, also has delays.

Network Rail Western said some services on Sunday morning could face delays and cancellations, caused by trains being displaced by the disruption.

Earlier on Saturday, Heathrow's southern runway was closed while crews tackled a grass fire on the airfield.

It caused some disruption with at least two flights diverted elsewhere. Heathrow apologised for any disruption and said the fire was extinguished quickly.

That comes weeks after another grass fire near Heathrow's southern runway which forced 18 flights to divert and destroyed a large area of grassland.

While weather has cooled across much of the UK in recent days following record-breaking heat over the summer, fire crews have still been warning of wildfire risks.

The Met Office's Fire Severity Index shows that if a wildfire was to occur, it would have a "high" fire severity in most of south-east England and some of the Midlands.

The fire severity is "exceptional", the highest level on the index, in some parts of London including Heathrow, as well as on the Essex and Suffolk coasts.

articles.body: The Minecraft 26.3 update has officially received its name: the Wilderness Bound update. Confirmed as the next Main Drop releasing this month, Wilderness Bound is shaping up to be one of the most charming and exploration-focused drops of the year.This is going to be pretty different from the underground-focused Chaos Cubed drop, and you can expect it to bring a variety of things, including a brand-new biome, a new wood type, camping-focused furniture blocks, and a new structure to discover out in the wild.In the section below, we provide you with everything we know about the Minecraft Wilderness Bound update, including its release date, features, and more.Minecraft Wilderness Bound update release dateMojang has not confirmed a concrete release date for the Minecraft 26.3 drop, but it is expected to arrive in the period of the next two weeks. This means that Wilderness Bound is likely to release around mid-September.Essentially, it will release as Java Edition 26.3 and Bedrock Edition 26.50. There are a lot of features arriving as part of the same, including the Dappled Forest biome, new blocks, and more.Minecraft Wilderness Bound update featuresThe Dappled Forest biomeDappled Forest is the new biome arriving with the Minecraft Wilderness Bound update, and it is filled with red, orange and yellow Poplar trees. Poplar saplings grow into any one of red, orange, or yellow poplar trees and can be sold by a wandering trader.Unstripped poplar logs can also be sold by wandering traders. The biome also features red shrubs, which are bush-like plant blocks found in small patches.New building blocksThe update adds wool stairs and slabs, concrete stairs and slabs, straw beds, and cushions to the game. Concrete stairs and concrete slabs round out the update across all sixteen dye colors.You can turn hardened concrete blocks into stairs and slabs just like stone, getting the flat architectural gradients that were previously impossible with plain full blocks. It is a long-overdue addition that the building community has been requesting for years.Straw Beds and CushionsStraw Beds are arriving with the new Minecraft update and they allow you to skip a night without changing the respawn point. You can find these beds at the Abandoned Camps or use 3x Hay Bales to craft one.Speaking of Cushions, they are a new decorative seat block that pair naturally with Straw Beds to give interiors a soft, homey layer that Minecraft's blocky palette has always struggled to deliver.Abandoned CampsA new structure called the abandoned camp is being added as part of the Wilderness Bound update. articles.title: 49ers dealt major blow before season opener as star player lands on injured reserve
articles.summary: San Francisco 49ers have made a significant roster move involving veteran defensive end Sam Okuayinonu after his foot injury ruled him out of their season op...
articles.body:
San Francisco 49ers have made a significant roster move involving veteran defensive end Sam Okuayinonu after his foot injury ruled him out of their season opener.

Okuayinonu has been placed on injured reserve, meaning he will miss at least the first four games of the 2026 season.

The defensive end did not travel to Australia with the rest of the 49ers after suffering the foot injury, and he was subsequently ruled out of San Francisco's Week 1 clash with the Los Angeles Rams.

Sam Okuayinonu placed on injured reserve

The latest move represents a further setback for Okuayinonu after the injury prevented him from joining the team in Australia.

"49ers sign Jon Weeks to 53 along with Khalid Kareem from practice squad, place Sam Okuayinonu on IR," Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston shared in a post on X.

Okuayinonu had played an unexpectedly important role for the 49ers in 2025. After featuring in a reserve role in 2024, he started 12 of the 15 games he played last season, recording 39 tackles, three sacks and a forced fumble.

His role was expected to decrease in 2026, but he was still projected to remain an important part of San Francisco's defensive line.

The foot injury has now disrupted those plans, with Okuayinonu set to miss at least the opening four games after being placed on injured reserve.

The 49ers also made additional roster moves alongside Okuayinonu's placement on IR, signing Jon Weeks to the 53-man roster and promoting Khalid Kareem from the practice squad.

Okuayinonu's absence now leaves San Francisco without the veteran defensive end for the opening stretch of the regular season as the team prepares to begin its campaign against the Rams.

articles.title: Why Nuggets Fans Should Believe Jokić’s ‘Okay’ Prediction
articles.summary: Nikola Jokić does not do empty optimism. So when the three-time MVP was asked about the Denver Nuggets’ decision to trade Peyton Watson and offered a calm as...
articles.body:
Nikola Jokić does not do empty optimism. So when the three-time MVP was asked about the Denver Nuggets' decision to trade Peyton Watson and offered a calm assessment of the team's future, it carried more weight than the usual offseason platitudes.

After leading Serbia past Victor Wembanyama and France in a FIBA World Cup qualifier, Jokić addressed the multi-team sign-and-trade that sent Watson to the Cleveland Cavaliers.

"I'm happy for Peyton," he said . "He deserved it. We will miss his energy and skill. I don't think about the season yet; we have to play this, but it's gonna be okay."

The quote, delivered while Jokić focused on national-team duties, quickly circulated among Nuggets fans still processing a first-round playoff exit and a quiet, financially constrained offseason. The natural question followed: Should they take him at his word?

Watson's Departure Left a Hole Denver Couldn't Fully Fill

Watson emerged as a key two-way piece in 2025-26. In 54 games (40 starts), the 6-foot-8 wing averaged 14.6 points, 4.9 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 0.9 steals and 1.1 blocks while shooting 49.1 percent from the field and 41.1 percent from three. His athleticism and defensive versatility filled a clear need alongside Jokić and Jamal Murray .

Denver ultimately signed-and-traded the restricted free agent to Cleveland as part of a multi-team deal. The Nuggets received an unprotected 2031 first-round pick from the Cavaliers and a 2032 second-round selection. No rotation player of note came back the other way. Cap and luxury-tax realities, including second-apron restrictions, heavily influenced the decision.

Days later, Denver signed veteran scorer DeMar DeRozan to a one-year, $3.9 million deal to bolster bench scoring and creation. The move added a proven mid-range specialist and secondary playmaker, but it did not fully replace Watson's two-way profile or youth.

Jokić Has Earned the Right to Be Taken at His Word

After the Nuggets' first-round loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves, Jokić did not sugarcoat the situation. He acknowledged the team was "far away" from true title contention while still reaffirming his desire to remain a Nugget long-term. That same straightforward style makes his more recent "okay" comment harder to dismiss as pure spin or public-relations damage control.

The 2025-26 season was plagued by injuries. Jokić missed time with a hyperextended left knee. Gordon dealt with hamstring and calf issues. Braun missed large stretches with an ankle sprain, Johnson was limited by a knee bone bruise, and Watson's hamstring injury kept him out of the playoffs entirely. Despite all of that, Denver still finished with 54 wins and the No. 3 seed.

Jokić averaged another near triple-double season, leading the league in both rebounds and assists. When healthy, the Jokić-Murray two-man game remains one of the most difficult actions in basketball to defend, and Gordon continues to provide the two-way versatility and physicality that complements the star center.

"Okay" may simply mean competitive and playoff-relevant rather than championship favorite. An honest reading of a roster operating under tight financial constraints.

The unprotected 2031 first-round pick acquired in the Watson deal gives Denver future asset flexibility that could be used to address depth or athleticism later. Jokić has repeatedly shown an ability to elevate the players around him, turning role players into productive pieces through his vision and decision-making.

His current priority remains practical: finishing national-team duties with Serbia before shifting full attention to training camp and the upcoming season. That grounded mindset has served him and the franchise for years.

Watson represented developing two-way athleticism and defensive versatility in the heart of Jokić's prime years. Losing that production without a comparable replacement thins the wing rotation at a time when the Western Conference is loaded with physical, switchable teams.

DeRozan helps on offense as a mid-range creator and secondary playmaker. However, at 37, he is a fundamentally different type of player—more isolation scorer than the athletic, switchable defender Watson provided.

The broader picture raises sharper questions. Injuries plagued the 2025-2026 season and repeatedly disrupted continuity. Multiple starters missed significant stretches, forcing the team to lean on younger or less proven pieces for long periods. Those absences contributed to an uneven regular season and left the roster less prepared for playoff physicality.

The No. 6-seeded Timberwolves eliminated the Nuggets 4-2 in the first round. This was even after Minnesota lost Anthony Edwards and other key contributors during the series. It marked the first time since 2022 that Denver failed to advance past the first round, exposing lingering issues with rebounding, defensive consistency, and supporting scoring.

The Cap, the Coach, and an Aging Core Add Uncertainty

Head coach David Adelman's situation adds another layer of uncertainty.

Denver fired Michael Malone late in the 2024-25 season, and Adelman stepped in as interim and guided the team to the second round. He earned the full-time job, but his first full season as head coach ended in that early exit.

While the front office has publicly backed him, the jump from successful assistant/interim to sustained head-coaching success is never guaranteed. The first-round loss invited scrutiny about scheme, adjustments, and in-game management against a physical opponent.

Looking ahead, the salary-cap picture is bleak for an aging core . The Nuggets are already operating deep into second-apron territory with massive contracts for Jokić, Murray, Gordon, Braun, and others. Denver projects enormous luxury-tax bills, and apron restrictions severely limit the ability to add meaningful talent via free agency or trade.

Jokić is 31; Murray and Gordon are also in or approaching their 30s. Without significant roster upgrades, the championship window could narrow.

Denver risks a stretch of competitive-but-not-elite seasons. Fans watched Watson break out, then watched him leave. Now they're asking: are low-cost moves like the DeRozan signing enough to keep Denver from settling for 'okay'?

Jokić Is Setting a Floor, Not Making a Promise

Jokić's comment is best read as a floor assessment, not a ceiling prediction.

The Nuggets remain a playoff team with arguably the best player in the world. They are not, on paper, the clear contender many hoped for after the championship core's earlier peaks.

Believing Jokić does not require ignoring the roster holes or financial limits. It means accepting that his honesty usually tracks reality. He is not promising a title run. He is saying the team will be functional and competitive, an understated baseline that matches both his personality and the current construction of the roster.

Whether that is enough for Nuggets fans depends on what they expect from the Jokić era in its later stages. The star has given his measured take. The front office still has work to do to make "okay" feel like more than a consolation.

articles.title: Top 5 features in Minecraft Wilderness Bound update
articles.summary: Esports News: Mojang is sending players back to the Overworld in style with the Minecraft Wilderness Bound update. The third game drop of 2026 is officially named, .
articles.body: Mojang is sending players back to the Overworld in style with the Minecraft Wilderness Bound update. The third game drop of 2026 is officially named, and it is shaping up to be one of the most exploration-friendly updates.After the underground-focused Chaos Cubed drop, Wilderness Bound pivots entirely toward outdoor adventure, camping, and a brand-new autumnal aesthetic. In the section below, we break down the top five features coming to Minecraft in the Wilderness Bound update.5 best features from the Minecraft Wilderness Bound updateListed below are the finest features from the upcoming Minecraft Wilderness Bound update:1. The Dappled Forest biomeThe undisputed headline addition of the Wilderness Bound update is the Dappled Forest, which is Minecraft's first genuinely autumn-coded biome. The forest features poplar trees that grow leaves in red, orange, and yellow shades. Along the forest floor, you can discover red shrubs, scattered leaf litter, and shelf mushrooms that sprout directly on tree trunks.Shelf mushrooms come in small and large variants, can be grown with bone meal, drop cooking ingredients for mushroom stew, and even provide a slight bouncy landing when stepped on. It is an extraordinarily detailed biome that feels genuinely alive in a way few Minecraft environments have before.2. Deserted CampsAbandoned camps are structures left behind by other adventurers, and you can find them in the dappled forest and surrounding areas. There are some small campsite buildings that contain wool tents, storage barrels and some valuable loot that is worth checking out.Lootable chests and treasure maps that point you to more exploration make for a great loop for survival players.3. Straw BedsThis is perhaps the most impactful feature of the update because Straw Beds solve a major dilemma for players who want to explore the massive world of Minecraft. Straw beds skip nights without changing respawn points and can be crafted from three hay bales. They can only be used once before being destroyed.For players going on long explorations, the ability to skip the night without permanently shifting your respawn location is a genuinely game-changing quality-of-life improvement.4. Cushions and the new furniture layerCushions finally let players sit in-game. It is a deceptively simple addition that builders and roleplayers have been requesting for years, and its arrival alongside Straw Beds gives Wilderness Bound a clear camping and comfort identity.Combined with the warm grey tone of the new Poplar wood set, interior design in Wilderness Bound is going to reach new heights.5. Concrete and wool stairs and slabsConcrete and wool finally gain matching stairs and slabs in all 16 dye colours. It is perhaps the least flashy feature on this list, but it is arguably the one the building community has wanted the longest.The addition addresses a long-standing community request for more architectural options.With a September 2026 release window, keep an eye on official Minecraft channels for the full launch date announcement.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: GTA 6 PC release date leak hints at earlier launch window
articles.summary: Esports News: GTA 6 is locked in for November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but Rockstar Games has still said nothing official about a PC version. .
articles.body: GTA 6 is locked in for November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but Rockstar Games has still said nothing official about a PC version. Into that silence, fresh speculation has emerged suggesting the wait for PC players might not be nearly as long as history would suggest.This has resulted in considerable excitement from the gaming community, who are eagerly awaiting information regarding GTA 6’s arrival on PC. The section below provides you with all the known details.GTA 6 could launch earlier on PC The latest chatter traces back to VGC editor-in-chief Andy Robinson, who raised the possibility during a recent episode of the VGC Podcast. Robinson said he believes Rockstar will move the PC release forward, describing "a bit of noise" around the idea that the port could land sooner than fans expect. He was careful to frame this as industry discussion rather than confirmed information, and he did not attach a specific date to his comments.This isn't the first time a shorter PC wait has been floated. A leaker going by DetectiveSeeds claimed that former Rockstar employees pointed to a possible February 2027 PC launch, tied to the company wanting the port out before the end of its fiscal year.Why an Earlier Launch for GTA ispossible?Rockstar's track record with previous entries doesn't exactly support a fast PC turnaround. Grand Theft Auto V took about a year and a half to reach PC after its console debut, and Red Dead Redemption 2 followed a similar pattern. If GTA 6 followed that precedent, PC players could be looking at a wait well into 2027 or beyond.However, the market looks different than it did in 2013 or 2018. PC gaming has grown substantially as a platform, while the cost of buying a new console has become a bigger barrier for many players. That shift gives Take-Two a commercial incentive to close the gap between console and PC releases, potentially unlocking another major sales window without forcing PC audiences to wait years.Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has previously explained the company's reasoning for a console-first approach, noting that Rockstar prioritizes its core console audience with initial launches.For now, everything points to speculation rather than confirmation. Rockstar's official GTA 6 site lists a release date only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with no mention of PC at all. Until the studio or Take-Two says otherwise, any specific PC date circulating online should be treated as a guess rather than fact. What does seem clear is that industry watchers increasingly expect Rockstar to shorten its usual console-to-PC gap, even if nobody outside the company knows by how much.This was all you needed to know about the latest news related to GTA 6’s release on PC.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Army Major quizzed as probe widens in armoury theft case
articles.summary: Army major questioned in Hyderabad’s Madras Regiment Bollarum armoury theft probe as investigators cite CCTV shutdowns, record lapses and INSAS magazine find.
articles.body: HYDERABAD: With investigators yet to crack the sensational theft of firearms from the Madras Regiment armoury in Bolarum, the probe has now climbed the chain of command, with officers responsible for supervising the facility’s security coming under scrutiny.After more than a week of sustained questioning of guards posted at the armoury failed to yield any breakthrough, investigators have widened their focus to include senior personnel overseeing security arrangements, including the unit commander, a Major-rank Army officer.Police sources said the officer commanding the army unit entrusted with securing the armoury is currently being questioned as part of the multi-agency investigation.“There are always two guards on rotational shift duty at the armoury, comprising KOTE (keeper of technical equipment), where firearms are stored and battalion magazine, where ammunition is stored. Their immediate boss is a non-commissioned officer (NCO) of Havildar rank. The supervisory officer who is the commander of the team is a Major,” an investigator said.The Major was stationed at the Madras Regiment in Bolarum when the burglary was reported to the police by a Lieutenant Colonel-rank officer on Aug 31.The investigation, being carried out jointly by the Madras Regiment, Military Intelligence, State Intelligence and Malkajgiri police, has so far involved the questioning of 10 to 15 Army personnel linked to guard duties at the armoury.“Despite the thorough interrogation for over a week since Aug 31, we are unable to get any breakthroughs. We are now questioning the officers supervising the guards, including NCOs, junior commissioned officers and the Major, since the burglary of this nature is not possible without anyone from the unit knowing about it,” a senior police officer said.Investigators said their decision to question supervisory officers was prompted not only by the lack of progress in the case but also by several security lapses uncovered during the probe. These include an alleged practice of switching off CCTV cameras at the armoury during the night and discrepancies in inventory records.Another issue that has drawn attention is the discovery of an empty INSAS rifle magazine during an inspection conducted shortly after the FIR was registered.“The Army personnel confirmed that the magazine was not part of the stolen ammunition, but they were unable to provide details of whom the magazine was issued to. They claim that information was not available in the records. articles.summary: Candidatos ao governo de RO, como Hildon Chaves e Marcos Rogério, realizaram carreatas e reuniões em Porto Velho e no interior nesta terça-feira (8).
articles.body:
Nesta terça-feira (8), todos os seis candidatos ao Governo de Rondônia nas eleições de 2026 cumpriram agenda de campanha em diferentes municípios do estado. Entre os compromissos estavam adesivaços, carreatas, reuniões, entrevistas, passeatas e gravações de programas eleitorais.

Confira abaixo a agenda de cada candidato:

O candidato do PSD cumpriu agenda em Rolim de Moura nesta terça-feira (8). As atividades começaram ainda nas primeiras horas da manhã, com uma reunião em um frigorífico do município.

Na sequência, o candidato visitou estabelecimentos comerciais da cidade, mantendo contato com trabalhadores e consumidores para ouvir reivindicações e apresentar propostas.

A programação foi encerrada no fim da tarde com a realização de um adesivaço e uma carreata, que percorreram vias de Rolim de Moura e reuniram apoiadores da campanha.

O candidato do PT cumpriu agenda nesta terça-feira (8) nos municípios de Cujubim (RO) e Machadinho d'Oeste (RO).

O candidato do União Brasil cumpriu agenda de campanha em Vilhena (RO) nesta terça-feira (8). As atividades começaram pela manhã com uma entrevista à imprensa local, seguida por ações de rua na Avenida Major Amarante e uma caminhada na Avenida Paraná, onde manteve contato com eleitores e apoiadores.

No período da tarde, o candidato concedeu entrevista a um programa de rádio local e participou de uma reunião com associados da Agrovila. A programação foi encerrada com um grande arrastão na Avenida Melvin Jones e no bairro Cristo Rei em Vilhena (RO).

O candidato do PL, cumpriu agenda de campanha em Porto Velho e Rolim de Moura (RO) nesta terça-feira (8). Durante o dia, participou de uma reunião interna com a coordenação de campanha e de uma sabatina em uma emissora de televisão na capital.

No período da tarde e noite, esteve em Rolim de Moura (RO), onde se reuniu com apoiadores e lideranças, participou de um adesivaço e encerrou a programação com uma reunião na Câmara de Vereadores do município.

O candidato pelo MDB cumpriu agenda de campanha nesta terça-feira (8) em Porto Velho. Pela manhã, participou de uma reunião com representantes de uma empresa privada e de um encontro com apoiadores.

Durante a tarde, realizou reuniões com a militância e participou da gravação de conteúdo para a campanha eleitoral. À noite, encerrou a programação com reuniões domiciliares nas zonas Leste e Norte, mantendo contato direto com eleitores e lideranças locais.

O candidato do PSB cumpriu agenda de campanha em Porto Velho nesta terça-feira (8). Ao longo do dia, participou de uma reunião interna com a equipe de campanha, de um encontro com apoiadores e realizou uma caminhada no centro da capital.

A programação foi encerrada à noite, com uma reunião voltada a apoiadores e lideranças comunitárias da zona sul de Porto Velho.

articles.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have wounded 73 civilians, official says
articles.summary: Spokesperson for Saudi-led coalition says Houthis have targeted civilian sites in Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran.
articles.body:
The Saudi Arabia-led coalition in Yemen says recent Houthi attacks on the kingdom’s southern provinces have wounded 73 civilians, including women and children, as cross-border attacks intensify alongside renewed fighting inside Yemen.

In a statement on Tuesday, coalition spokesperson Major-General Turki al-Maliki said the attacks targeted civilian and economic sites in Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran.

He did not specify when the attacks took place.

Al-Maliki described the attacks as a “dangerous escalation” and a “blatant violation” of Saudi Arabia’s sovereignty that posed a direct threat to the kingdom’s citizens and residents.

He warned that the coalition would take “all necessary operational measures” to confront the attacks and act against the sources of the threat.

articles.body: At official ceremonies at Rashtrapati Bhavan, the President is often surrounded by senior officials, dignitaries and military personnel. Among them is a young Army officer who has recently drawn attention- Major Navya Shekhawat.Major Shekhawat is serving as an Aide-de-Camp (ADC) to President Droupadi Murmu, becoming the first woman officer from the Indian Army to hold the position. Her appointment comes after Lieutenant Commander Yashasvi Solanki of the Indian Navy became the first woman overall to serve as a President's ADC in 2025.What does a President's ADC do?The title may sound ceremonial, but the ADC's role involves much more than simply accompanying the President at public events. The President traditionally has five ADCs- three from the Army, one from the Navy and one from the Air Force. These officers assist the President during official engagements and ceremonies and play an important role in maintaining military and ceremonial protocol.Major Navya Shekhawat's journey began with the CDS examinationLike many young Indians aspiring to join the armed forces, Shekhawat's route into the Army began with the Combined Defence Services (CDS) examination, conducted by the Union Public Service Commission.According to Moneycontrol and The Better India, she secured a place in the merit list for the Short Service Commission Women Non-Technical Course and subsequently underwent training at the Officers Training Academy (OTA), Chennai.After completing her training, Shekhawat was commissioned into the Army Service Corps (ASC). The corps is responsible for important logistical functions, including supplies, transportation and other systems required to keep military formations operational.Shekhawat was commissioned around the middle of 2021 and rose to the rank of Major within a few years. Her appointment as the President's ADC in 2026 therefore came roughly five years after she began her commissioned service.She is the second woman to serve as President's ADCWhile Major Shekhawat is the first woman from the Indian Army to hold the President's ADC position, she is not the first woman officer overall to enter the President's ADC team. That distinction belongs to Lieutenant Commander Yashasvi Solanki of the Indian Navy, who became the first woman ADC to the President in 2025.Major Shekhawat's achievement comes against the backdrop of several decades of change in the role of women in India's military. Women began entering the Indian Army through the Short Service Commission route in 1992. articles.title: Colombia's new president loosens gun control rules
articles.summary: President Abelardo de la Espriella has lifted a decade-long suspension on permits to carry legal firearms.
articles.body:
Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has signed a decree which eases restrictions on people carrying legal firearms in public.

De la Espriella, who during his campaign for the presidency promised to take an iron-fist approach to crime, said it was "not right that criminals are armed to the teeth while decent people can't defend themselves".

The decree lifts a suspension that had been in force for a decade, which meant that even those in possession of a permit to carry guns could not do so without additional authorisation.

De la Espriella insisted that the decree would not create a free-for-all and that tight controls over who can own a gun would remain in place.

While signing the decree, the president said he had made good on his campaign promise: "A man's word is his honour, and I have honour, that's why I keep my word."

The restriction on carrying legal guns in public was brought in by the then-President Juan Manuel Santos in December 2015. It was originally meant to be a temporary measure, aimed at improving security during the Christmas and New Year festivities.

But the suspension was extended yearly by Santos and two subsequent presidents from opposing sides of the political spectrum: conservative Iván Duque and left-wing Gustavo Petro.

Under the law, even those with a permit to carry a gun could not take it out of their homes unless they applied for - and were granted - additional authorisation.

De la Espriella has insisted that his decree has removed a restriction which had never been meant to be permanent.

According to Spanish newspaper El País, the decree will affect almost 700,000 people in Colombia who are already in possession of a legal permit to carry a gun.

They will now be able to take their registered gun out of their home, provided their permits remain up to date.

Green Alliance Party Senator Ariel Ávila described the move as a "grave error", arguing that legally held guns would end up in the hands of criminals.

Ávila insisted that it created an ethical dilemma, as it should only be state forces that carry guns and act as guarantors of people's security.

De la Espriella insisted that the measure would not negatively affect security in the country and said forces were targeting those holding illegal guns and had seized more than 15,000 firearms so far this year.

Most of them, according to de la Espriella, belonged to members of breakaway factions of the Farc rebel group and the Gulf Clan criminal gang.

articles.title: Valorant Cheater Using Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur Skin Banned After Viral Video Sparks Backlash Against Riot's Anti-Cheat
articles.summary: A hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has been banned after wreaking havoc in Valorant lobbies and decimating entire teams.
articles.body:
A hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has been banned after wreaking havoc in Valorant lobbies and decimating entire teams.

Cheaters are a never-ending issue in online multiplayer games, but some are more memorable than others. A recent hacking incident has produced possibly one of the most memorable cheaters of all — or at least, one of the most visually disturbing.

As pointed out by Dexerto , a hacker using an ‘Evil’ Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin has sparked backlash within the Valorant community, and it’s not hard to see why. The skin, modeled after the viral brainrot meme Tung Tung Tung Sahur, has transformed the character into a deranged-looking, evil version of himself. (I choose to believe that Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur is the ‘Evil Ryu’ to Tung Tung Tung Sahur’s normal form.)

Evil Tung activities | #VALORANT pic.twitter.com/wQaPMF7TxD — Valorant Tactic (@valorantactic) September 9, 2026

Evil Tung activities | #VALORANT pic.twitter.com/wQaPMF7TxD

Footage of the hacker went viral on social media, showing the cheater in third-person from what appears to be their own perspective. We can see the outlines of enemies through walls as Evil Tung walks backwards, shooting his gun at nothing — only for his opponents to drop like flies in a blink.

This video showed that the cheater seemed to have enabled wallhacks and auto-targeting, but it’s uncertain if they were using any other methods to decimate these lobbies. It took the Valorant community by storm, prompting popular analyst ‘vladk0r’ to post it as a jab against Riot's kernel-level anti-cheat system, Vanguard.

“Imagine losing to a team with this s**t only for them being banned later after [a] few rounds of the bracket, and not being able to do anything with this, ‘cause they got DQ’d much later after your match, so Riot can't revert the results,” he wrote .

“Proof that kernel-level anti-cheat compromises user privacy and security for nothing,” another player argued . “Cheaters own and control the hardware the game runs on, they always find a way eventually. You don't need more privilege in a client-side AC, you need server-side AC and behavioural analysis.”

“Kernel-level anti-cheat really thought it could stop Tung Tung Tung Cheat-Hur,” another joked .

Thankfully, Valorant lobbies weren’t plagued for much longer; Riot’s anti-cheat director Phillip Koskinas responded to the issue in a tweet confirming that the cheater had been banned, along with their Riot ID, the name of their cheat (which Koskinas dubbed ‘lowskill vibeslop’), and how many games they’d played.

“We can detect anything with time, but VAL is a free to play game. Agree that we have to improve pre-emptive posture for open qualifiers,” he wrote, adding that it was “pointless” to hide the hacker’s Riot ID.

Riot ID: FaeL o Anacondo#br1 Banned: 2026-09-03 Games Played: 3 Cheat Name: "Sysinfo" (lowskill vibeslop) Hiding the Riot ID: Pointless We can detect anything with time, but VAL is a free to play game. Agree that we have to improve pre-emptive posture for open qualifiers. — Phillip Koskinas (@deteccphilippe) September 9, 2026

Riot ID: FaeL o Anacondo#br1 Banned: 2026-09-03 Games Played: 3 Cheat Name: "Sysinfo" (lowskill vibeslop) Hiding the Riot ID: Pointless We can detect anything with time, but VAL is a free to play game. Agree that we have to improve pre-emptive posture for open qualifiers.

This dastardly, if disturbingly creative, cheater finally got what was coming to them after ruining games for so many players. Evil Tung Tung Tung Sahur’s wrath has ended.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.body:
Exposição no Pátio Limeira Shopping resgata história da Festa da Laranja — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

A história de Limeira e a importância da citricultura para o desenvolvimento econômico e social do município ganham espaço no Pátio Limeira Shopping , administrado pelo Grupo AD, com a exposição “Festa da Laranja: história, cultura e memória”. A mostra poderá ser visitada de 12 a 21 de setembro e reunirá imagens das primeiras edições da tradicional Festa da Laranja, digitalizadas pela equipe do Museu Major José Levy Sobrinho, além de textos que apresentam a trajetória do evento sob os pontos de vista econômico, político e social.

A exposição chega ao shopping em um momento especialmente simbólico para Limeira, que em 2026 comemora 200 anos. A mostra será um esquenta para a 14ª Festa da Laranja de Limeira que será realizada entre os dias 24 e 27 de setembro, no Parque Cidade. A festa contará com apresentações musicais, área gastronômica, parque de expositores com empresas de diversos segmentos e opções de lazer para toda a família, além de um parque de diversões dentro do recinto.

O Pátio Limeira Shopping , patrocinador da 14ª Festa da Laranja, reforça o compromisso com iniciativas que promovem a cultura e a valorização da história do município.

“Receber essa exposição no Pátio é uma forma de preparar a cidade para esta edição tão especial da Festa da Laranja. O bicentenário torna este momento ainda mais significativo e queremos contribuir para que nossos clientes possam conhecer um pouco mais dessa trajetória”, afirma Sibelly Paganotti, coordenadora de Marketing do Pátio Limeira Shopping .

A exposição “Festa da Laranja: história, cultura e memória” poderá ser visitada gratuitamente no piso superior, próximo ao cinema Arcoplex.

Com 64 mil m² de área construída, o Pátio Limeira Shopping possui mais de 150 operações, sendo cinco lojas-âncoras (Marisa, C&A, Riachuelo, Lojas Americanas e Renner), seis megalojas (Ri Happy, Centauro, Di Gaspi, Polo Wear, Kalunga e Lojas 1a99), mais de 30 operações de alimentação e quatro restaurantes (Outback, Coco Bambu, Pizza Hut e Sr. Boteco) e o cinema Arcoplex, com cinco salas, sendo uma 3D. Anexo ao Pátio Limeira Shopping está o Pátio Office, torre comercial com dez andares e 160 salas modulares. Localizado na região central de Limeira, o empreendimento é um importante local de compras, lazer e entretenimento para adultos e crianças da cidade e região, oferecendo excelentes opções com segurança e estacionamento coberto para mil veículos, com sinalizadores.

Brandon Aiyuk is not playing for the San Francisco 49ers right now, and he will not be part of the team's Week 1 lineup against the Los Angeles Rams .

Demarcus Robinson is wearing No. 11, the number formly worn by Aiyuk.

Brandon Aiyuk Will Not Play for 49ers in Week 1

San Francisco instead lists Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Sr. as its starting wide receivers, with De'Zhaun Stribling, Demarcus Robinson, Jacob Cowing and Jordan Watkins among the options behind them.

Aiyuk also is not part of the team's Week 1 injury report because this is no longer simply an injury-status question.

The former second-team All-Pro has not played in an NFL game since suffering a major knee injury against the Kansas City Chiefs in October 2024. He missed the entire 2025 season before San Francisco placed him on the reserve/left squad list in December.

articles.title: Knicks Should Turn to Veteran Big Man for Their 14th Roster Spot
articles.summary: The New York Knicks don't have many obvious holes to worry about heading into next season. This is already one of the best rosters in basketball, so the 14th...
articles.body:
The New York Knicks don't have many obvious holes to worry about heading into next season. This is already one of the best rosters in basketball, so the 14th roster spot doesn't need to be a move that changes the entire team. New York can afford to be selective and look for someone who can quietly provide something useful when the situation calls for it.

There are a few different directions the Knicks could take. They could add another shooter, bring in some younger talent, or look for another veteran voice. But one of the most practical options might be adding another big man.

Karl-Anthony Towns and Andre Drummond give the Knicks two options at center, but adding a veteran behind them would give really valuable insurance.

That's where Drew Eubanks could make sense. Eubanks is currently an unrestricted free agent, and the Knicks could use their final spot to add a player who doesn't need a major role to be useful.

Knicks 14th Roster Spot: Eubanks Could Give New York Some Extra Insurance

Eubanks isn't the kind of signing that's going to change the Knicks' outlook for the upcoming season completely. That's also not really the point. Instead, he'd give New York another option at center and some additional frontcourt depth behind Towns and Drummond. For a team that doesn't necessarily need to make a major addition, that could be exactly what the 14th roster spot is for.

Eubanks has really established himself as a reliable third-string center. If the Knicks brought him in to give some stability in their upcoming season , that's likely where he'd fit on the depth chart.

Eubanks wouldn't need to walk into New York expecting a featured role. The Knicks would have another experienced big man available if needed. That's extra useful when the roster is already as strong as New York's. The 14th player doesn't have to be someone who demands minutes every night. Sometimes, having a dependable option waiting on the bench is enough.

Eubanks played 42 games for the Sacramento Kings last season. He's also played with the LA Clippers , Utah Jazz and Phoenix Suns . That experience gives the Knicks another reason to consider him. He's familiar with being a depth player and wouldn't need the team to reshape its plans around him completely.

The Knicks Don't Need to Overthink This Spot

New York has several ways it could use its final roster spot. More three-point shooting would be helpful. Adding youth is another possibility. The Knicks could even decide that another veteran leader is what the group needs.

But something is appealing about keeping the decision simple. Adding Eubanks would give New York another center behind Towns and Drummond without asking him to become something he's not. He could serve as low-cost insurance and provide the Knicks with another option if they need help in the frontcourt. He'd also be fun to watch with Jalen Brunson to some capacity on the court . That's a really good use of the 14th spot for a team that doesn't have a glaring weakness to fix.

The Knicks don't need this roster move to produce a star. They don't need someone who completely changes the team's identity. They need to find a player who can make the roster a little deeper and give them another option when the season gets complicated. Eubanks fits that description. He won't solve all of their concerns , but he'll help.

He may not be the most exciting name New York could add, but the 14th roster spot doesn't need to be super exciting. A reliable veteran big man who can step in when needed could be a much more useful addition.

articles.title: Levi Onwuzurike released by Lions
articles.summary: The Lions released defensive lineman Levi Onwuzurike and rookie Tyre West in a move to adjust their roster.
articles.body:
The Detroit Lions on Friday, Sept. 11, released defensive lineman Levi Onwuzurike from the active roster and rookie defensive lineman Tyre West from the practice squad, according to an announcement from the team.

Onwuzurike, a second-round pick in general manager Brad Holmes' first draft class (2021) , seemed to potentially be on the roster bubble after a slow start to camp but wound up sticking on the 53-man roster as the Lions kept 11 defensive linemen in total. Lions coach Dan Campbell previously said Onwuzurike was on a "ramp-up plan" after coming off a knee injury that cost him his entire 2025 season .

It's possible we haven't seen the last of Onwuzurike in Detroit, and that this is simply a move to avoid guaranteeing his $1.2 million salary for 2026.

"He looks great," Campbell said of Onwuzurike on Aug. 17. "I would say when you are coming off that injury, your ability to train now, being healthy basically, right? So, now you're kind of out of that rehab mode, and now you're into truly strength, conditioning, training, power, explosion, all of it. So, he's just continued that route."

Onwuzurike was rather effective as a pass rusher the last time he was healthy during the regular season, recording 45 pressures and 1½ sacks in 2024, when the defensive line was otherwise decimated by injuries.

West, a rookie whom Detroit selected with a seventh-round pick in April, struggled to gain any momentum throughout camp, to the point that he only played 10 snaps in preseason.

articles.body:
Overwatch 2 is getting a brand-new vampire-inspired support hero, as well as the conclusion of Act III in The Reign of Talon storyline and several big character changes.

Our new addition is Doctrine, a vampire support hero who deals lots of damage and healing with a high mechanical floor. He comes with a brand-new playable escort map, Watch Point Grimsvotn, a volcanic prison where he’s being held captive. What’s more, he’ll be playable for a trial weekend starting today, September 12, both on the Blizzcon convention floor and at home.

In other big news, Overwatch Season 5 begins on October 6. Dokiwatch is also returning, and there are some major character reworks planned: Roadhog is being reworked into a tank that “actually helps his team,” per Blizzard franchise leaders, while Sombra is moving into the support class.

The Overwatch 2026 World Cup Finals are also taking place at Blizzcon this weekend, featuring live performances from Japanese pop group YOASOBI and K-Pop group LE SSERAFIM.

A new hero was also mentioned coming in Season 6, as well as a new Spotlight happening in February 2027, which will include a "new story, a fresh set of heroes, and amazing new systems" that the team said will bring the game back to "peak Overwatch."

Also taking place this weekend is a special event that Overwatch has never done before; at Blizzcon, the voice of Cole Cassidy, Matt Mercer, will be leading an Overwatch tabletop RPG session, leading the voice actors for Symmetra, Sombra, Reinhardt, and Vendetta in a one-of-a-kind story built especially for this convention. Blizzcon will also be auctioning off figures, merchandise, artwork, collectibles, and more to benefit Make-A-Wish.

We also have to mention Overwatch's collaboration with LE SSERAFIM, which is available now. This collab includes stylish themed cosmetics, emotes, and in-game challenges.

Just as fans of the long-running hero shooter took to social media to celebrate the reveal of Overwatch's new vampire-themed Support Hero, Blizzard snuck in another surprise with a post on its social media page. What seemed to be an innocent enough post showed off the full new Hero roster for 2026 – but wait, who's that?

Doctrine has joined Jetpack Cat, Anran, Emre, Dmon, Mizuki, Shion, Domina, and Sierra, but tucked in the far-right side of the group photo is a character no one has ever seen before. It turns out the image included a first look at a yet-to-be-named Omnic with a robotic trench coat, a swanky hat, and what seems to be an umbrella weapon. All we know for now is that he is Hero 55 and he's another Support, and fans, of course, are losing their minds at the nonchalant reveal.

articles.summary: We are just over a month away from the start of the 2026-27 season, and the Los Angeles Lakers still stand with clear roster needs. (Yes, with an s.)There ha...
articles.body:
We are just over a month away from the start of the 2026-27 season, and the Los Angeles Lakers still stand with clear roster needs. (Yes, with an s.)

There has been chatter about the Lakers potentially looking to address the frontcourt by signing a free agent, but there aren't particularly flattering options on the open market for the Lakers to choose from.

"The Lakers already added Walker Kessler , Kevon Looney , Matisse Thybulle and Ziaire Williams during an offseason focused heavily on defense and roster balance, but questions remain about their frontcourt depth and size at forward," Ryan Anderson of the California Post wrote. " Dwight Powell has been mentioned as one realistic minimum-salary option because of his extensive history playing alongside Luka Doncic in Dallas. Drew Eubanks , Bismack Biyombo and Mason Plumlee also remain among the available veteran big men."

L.A. could go after any of these seasoned big men, but that should be the last resort. The team is said to be exploring trades, with forwards Dalton Knecht and Jarred Vanderbilt reportedly in the mix as two players the Lakers are aiming to move. Could L.A. land an impact player in a deal involving either Knecht or Vanderbilt?

Lakers Could Make Move for Starting Wing

Knecht and Vanderbilt don't have much trade value around the NBA , as has been often reported this summer, but even if the Lakers were to move one of the two, team insider Jovan Buha believes L.A. should not execute a trade that brings back Kyle Kuzma .

"In terms of wings, this gets a bit more interesting," Buha said. "There are guys like Cameron Johnson , Kyle Kuzma , De'Andre Hunter, Dillon Brooks . … Potentially Johnson, Kuzma or Hunter for the non taxpayer MLE. My strong preference would be Johnson among this group. And then honestly, I might even go Hunter over Kuzma. I think that's close. I would honestly want to stay away from either one of those guys and view those guys more as bench wings than starting-level wings."

Kumza and Hunter are two names Lakers insider Khobi Price mentioned as strong potential candidates to address L.A.'s wing need. Kumza, now of the Milwaukee Bucks , was once viewed as a future franchise cornerstone in L.A. before he was traded as a part of a deal that brought Russell Westbrook to town. Hunter, meanwhile, is someone the Lakers explored in the recent past, according to Price.

Both Kuzma and Hunter are on expiring contracts and are candidates to be moved by their respective team sometime between now and next season's trade deadline.

If the Lakers pushed hard enough to acquire Kuzma, it likely wouldn't be an exhausting effort. This offseason, the Bucks ripped off a blockbuster trade that shipped out franchise icon Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Miami Heat . As a result, veterans like Kuzma are immediately expendable.

As Bucks reporter Tre Allen noted, Kuzma doesn't appear to be a long-term piece for a rebuilding Milwaukee team that has young players at Kuzma's positions who are expected to rise up the depth chart.

"Now entering the final season of his contract, it's going to be a big season for the 9-year veteran who's on a Bucks team entering a rebuild," Allen wrote. "His presence as a veteran will help this youthful team with a lot of new faces, but he might not be part of the long-term future. All summer long, the 31-year-old has been linked to trade talks due his expiring deal and tradable contract, and with young forwards like rookie Nate Ament or even Ousmane Dieng , Milwaukee has other options if they choose to move on from him."

Kuzma is similar to the player he was when he left L.A. five years ago. He can provide instant offense but isn't much of a dependable option on the other side of the ball.

At this point at least, it appears unlikely that the Lakers view Kuzma as the best option to pursue.

articles.title: Overwatch Devs Confirm That Yes, Tracer Is Still The Game’s Mascot
articles.summary: You heard it here first, folks: Tracer is still the face of Overwatch, despite not being featured in many major collaborations or promotional materials as of late.
articles.body:
You heard it here first, folks: Tracer is still the face of Overwatch , despite not being featured in many major collaborations or promotional materials as of late.

We got the chance to sit down with the minds behind Overwatch at Blizzcon 2026 to discuss the game’s newest support hero, Doctrine , and the future of the franchise — as well as grill them about Tracer’s role as its supposed mascot.

When you think about Overwatch, you probably think of Tracer. She was essentially the star of the show when the game first launched in 2016, and was consistently featured in marketing materials, merchandise, advertisements, and more. Her iconic silhouette and speedy abilities were inescapable back then… but now, not so much.

Overwatch: Tracer - London Calling Graphic Novel Preview

We directly asked Overwatch’s Lead Hero Producer Kenny Hudson, as well as art director Dion Rogers, if Tracer is still the mascot of the game — or if she was ever really considered its mascot, at all.

Their answer was firm and decisive: Tracer is, and always was, the mascot of Overwatch.

“Tracer is still the mascot for Overwatch. Very much. ‘Tracer orange’ is a quote that the team uses all the time. The little cheeto on top of the sigil is orange. She’s still that girl,” Rogers told us.

Overwatch just got a brand-new support hero in Doctrine, a vampire-inspired character who has a long history with Doomfist. No, he’s not an actual vampire, but that motif was a key part of his design from the very beginning, says Rogers.

“The idea came from our lead narrative designer, Miranda Moyer, who actually asked the question of, ‘What would a vampire look like in the Overwatch universe?’ We always do our best work on heroes when we get a really cool theme to rally around, and ‘vampire’ just got the brain juices flowing on everything from kit, to concept, to art,” he explained.

“This one was fun, because with Hero 54, we’ve hit all the archetypes like cowboy, knight, ninja. Once we thought about the vampire, we were like, ‘Yeah, let’s lean into it and see if we can make a hero out of this,’” Hudson added.

“He’s still a scientist or a mechanical engineer, even his cape still feels like a lab coat from the sciency part of him. …we started him off as a scientist, a typical guy, lab coat, glasses. Sometimes it takes a team saying when they see an image, ‘That’s the hero.’ He didn’t quite feel like it yet. But we took the vampire thing that Miranda mentioned, we applied that, and he actually started to feel like a hero. You can see a theme, you can see a fantasy, you can see an archetype. Making him hail from Zimbabwe, Africa, gives him that immediate heritage and connection to Doomfist. He worked for Doomfist’s family at some point in his life, and helped build arms for Doomfist, so it made sense that he would reach out to him to get his arm back.”

Doctrine is the nearly the last of 10 characters who have come to Overwatch this year. With so much content dropping into the game in 2026, we had to ask about what peaks are left for Overwatch to climb, and what’s in the pipeline next.

“There’s always room for more heroes,” Rogers said. “There’s a lot more we’re cooking.”

“It’s not so much about hitting the targets we’ve already hit, but setting new ones and seeing where we can take it,” Hudson added. “We’re really excited with all the team has learned over the last couple of years to be able to really push ourselves into new territory and evolve in new, interesting ways.”

Doctrine was one of several massive announcements shown off at Blizzcon this year, and there's still more to come; Hero 55 was also teased this weekend, and he's a suave-looking Omnic who fans are already itching to play. You can out our recap blog for full breakdown of everything revealed, as well as our interview with the team behind the upcoming StarCraft open-world shooter coming in 2030.

articles.title: Houthis say air strikes hit Yemen after Saudi Arabia vows ‘firm’ response
articles.summary: Saudi-led coalition promises to respond ‘firmly’ to Houthi strikes on urban areas in Saudi Arabia.
articles.body:
Yemen’s Houthi rebels have accused Saudi Arabia of launching dozens of air attacks across Yemen, after the Saudi-led coalition promised to respond “firmly” to missile and drone attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis that wounded 13 civilians across three cities in the kingdom.

The Saudi-led coalition, which backs Yemen’s internationally recognised government, said early on Tuesday that Houthi attacks on Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif caused minor to moderate injuries, damaging seven homes and two vehicles.

“The Joint Forces Command of the Coalition will deal with these attacks responsibly and firmly to protect the sovereignty of the kingdom,” said coalition spokesperson Major-General Turki al-Maliki.

Later on Tuesday, the Houthis, also known as Ansar Allah (supporters of God), said Saudi Arabia launched 54 air raids across the governorates of Lahj, Taiz, al-Jawf, Marib and Hajjah in the past 24 hours.

The group said Saudi air strikes hit the government complex in Khadir district, Taiz governorate, causing injuries.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said F-15 and Typhoon fighter jets operating from Saudi airbases in Khamis Mushait and Taif were used in the strikes and threatened retaliation.

Houthi-aligned media reported that the Saudi attacks killed three civilians, including two children, and injured at least two others in Taiz province’s Dhubab and Maqbanah districts.

Saudi Arabia has not commented publicly on the Houthi claims. The Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not respond to a request for comment.

The attacks come after the Iran-aligned group said on Monday that it fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid airbase in Khamis Mushait, targeting hangars, radar systems, runways and ammunition depots, in retaliation for Saudi air raids across Yemen.

The Houthis said in a statement on Monday that Saudi warplanes had carried out 300 air raids across Yemen over the previous five days

The exchanges of air attacks follow the Houthis’ rapid advance on the ground in western Yemen last week, with the group gaining control over much of Yemen’s Red Sea coast and advancing to areas adjacent to the Bab al-Mandeb strait.

The strait has become a vital waterway for energy and commercial shipping in the region as the US-Iran war has caused major disruption to the Strait of Hormuz.

The forces of Yemen’s internationally recognised government said on Monday that they made advances in the contested Taiz province after retaking positions from the Houthis, and had struck the group’s fighters and equipment in Dhubab and al-Khokha on the Red Sea coast.

Al Jazeera could not independently verify battlefield claims.

Houthi and Yemeni government officials said on Monday that the Houthis had seized the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands in the southern Red Sea, about 160km (100 miles) north of the Bab al-Mandeb. Their recent advances also include Mayyun Island, at the mouth of the Red Sea.

Yemen’s more than decade-long war reignited in July, as the Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia and began attacking its ships in the Red Sea, threatening a 2022 United Nations-brokered ceasefire that halted large-scale violence.

articles.body:
The Rays acquired Joe Boyle , the towering, hard-throwing reliever, from the Athletics as part of the trade for Jeffrey Springs and Jacob Lopez . Since then he's pitched just over 70 innings for the Rays, spending most of his time in Durham.

This year Joe Boyle has made meaningful strides in his command while retaining the stuff that made him an intriguing pitching prospect. In limited major-league opportunities, his topline numbers haven't been great but there's no question has major league stuff and the upside that goes with it. Boyle has developed enough command to support an increasingly sophisticated arsenal, and his ability to adjust that arsenal on the fly is what makes his starter projection particularly interesting.

Before joining the Rays, Boyle posted a 15.7% walk rate in the majors and an 18.9% walk rate in the minors. Since joining the organization, those numbers have fallen to 12.1% and 14.4%, respectively. This is meaningful growth driven by some mechanical adjustments, usage rates, and shape changes.

Boyle has gone from a high three-quarter slot delivery through 2024 to a low three-quarter slot delivery in 2025 and 2026. The lower slot seems to suit him better, giving him a more repeatable delivery and helping him find the zone more consistently.

The adjustment appears to have given Boyle a more consistent foundation from which to repeat his delivery and attack the strike zone. His zone rate has gone from 44.2% in AAA in 2024 to 46.9% in AAA so far in 2026 – despite shifting toward a more secondary-heavy mix, with his non-fastballs historically less likely to land in the zone. And because he has the quality stuff to stick in a rotation, the next step was to revamp his arsenal to attack both sides of the plate.

Here are Boyle's Triple-A usage rates to righties and lefties in each of the last three seasons:

Boyle is now throwing a wider variety of shapes – most of them relatively new given his change in slot – and he's still filling up the zone at a higher rate than ever before. He has more advanced feel and pitchability than he gets credit for. Boyle's command gains coupled with an expanded arsenal are more exciting than either development would be on its own.

Some interesting things have happened with Boyle's usage and cut-slider shape during the 2026 season so far that give even more reason to be excited. The changes become even more interesting when we look at how he's using each pitch against right- and left-handed hitters.

The biggest thing that stands out to me is that Boyle's fastball usage has fallen below 50% against both sides of the plate for the first time in his professional career. His cut-slider is now his highest usage pitch and for good reason: it's the pitch he commands best. I wondered what it would look like if he pitched off of his cut-slider back in January because he has the best location consistency of that pitch.

Boyle's cut-slider has gradually evolved since he joined the Rays. Before joining the organization, the pitch looked more like a traditional two-plane slider, with velocity in the mid-to-upper 80s. By April of 2025, it had developed a tighter, gyro shape. Since his August major-league call-up this season, Boyle has pushed the pitch even further toward a harder, cutter-like offering. It now sits in the low 90s and, for the first time, is more vertically oriented. The pitch's zone rate has increased from 52.5% to 60.6% with the new shape, while maintaining a whiff rate in the 35-40% range. That suggests Boyle has improved his ability to locate the pitch without sacrificing its bat-missing ability.

Since returning to Durham with this new cut-slider shape, Boyle has cut his walk rate to 7.3% across 19.1 innings in four appearances. His strike rate has also climbed from 57.7% to 64.1%, moving from below average to roughly league average. While the sample is small, the trends are encouraging – Boyle is throwing more strikes.

The growth we've seen from Boyle makes me more confident he can stick as a major-league starter, and potentially more than just a back-end option. The stuff has always been there; now his command is becoming good enough to let that arsenal play consistently. The most exciting developments this season have been his ability to improve his zone rate while increasing his secondary usage and his ability to manipulate his cut-slider shape in-season.

The Rays could always simplify Boyle's arsenal in relief, where his fastball and cut-slider combination would give him a relatively straightforward path to success. But the organization's continued investment in his expanded arsenal suggests they see more than a relief role in him. His improved command and ability to manipulate pitch shapes are precisely what give him a chance to remain in a rotation. Whether that opportunity comes down the stretch in 2026 or beyond, Boyle has developed into a legitimate candidate for a major-league rotation spot.

articles.body:
The Colorado Avalanche released their training camp roster for the upcoming 2026-27 season on Tuesday. They'll have 29 forwards, 20 defensemen, and seven goalies in attendance.

Camp begins with media day on Wednesday, followed by three consecutive days of on-ice sessions from Thursday to Saturday. The preseason begins on Sunday at Ball Arena.

This will be the first year under the new collective bargaining agreement, where training camp and preseason are accelerated. When the Avs take the ice on Thursday, it'll be just 13 days before opening night. They will also play just four preseason games with veterans who have played more than 100 career games capped at just two games.

articles.title: ESPN Predicts Celtics Will Part Ways with Derrick White, Payton Pritchard and More
articles.summary: The bold prediction is part of ESPN's three-year outlook for all 30 NBA teams.
articles.body:
The Boston Celtics could be in line for even more roster turnover over the next few years.

Heading into the 2026-27 NBA season, ESPN's NBA insiders ranked all 30 teams based on their three-year outlook.

The good news for the Celtics is that they rose from ranking 13th last year to third this year, trailing only the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs .

The less encouraging news is that ESPN's Ben Golliver made a bold prediction that involves even more change.

"Bold prediction for 2027-29: Tatum will be the only member of the Celtics' 2024 championship team still on the roster entering the 2029-30 season," writes Golliver . "After trading Brown this summer, Boston is down to just six members of its title team: Tatum, Derrick White , Payton Pritchard , Sam Hauser , Neemias Queta and Jordan Walsh . With Boston's new ownership making sharp cuts in the second apron era, the only constant has been change."

That doesn't necessarily mean the Celtics will trade those players.

Pritchard can become a free agent after the 2027-28 season, while White and Hauser could remain under contract through 2028-29.

Queta is under contract through 2030-31, so he would have to be traded for Golliver's prediction to come true. Walsh, meanwhile, has a team option for 2029-30.

"The Celtics restocked their draft assets, picking up two valuable firsts from Philadelphia in the Jaylen Brown trade," writes Bobby Marks . "As a result, Boston has four available firsts and Paul George 's contract to use in trade discussions. The question, however, is whether Boston adds another max contract to pair with Tatum or adds multiple players to help balance the roster."

As part of ESPN's analysis, the Celtics finished second in management. That should give fans confidence that Brad Stevens and the front office are well-suited to navigate whatever changes come next.

articles.title: British soldier who died in Ukraine road accident named by MoD
articles.summary: Tributes have been paid to Major Paul Wilks, who was described as a "gifted leader".
articles.body:
The member of the UK armed forces who died in a road traffic accident in Ukraine last week has been named as Major Paul Wilks.

The Ministry of Defence (MoD) described the 40-year-old as a "gifted leader who earned the admiration and respect of all those fortunate enough to have served alongside him".

The incident on Saturday was not the result of hostile action, the BBC understands, with the MoD stating that the accident happened "away from the front lines".

Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said: "Major Wilks served this country with pride and dedication. His loss will be deeply felt by those around him."

He said: "The tributes paid by those who worked with Paul illustrate his exceptional talent and ability, underscored by genuine warmth, compassion and a desire to support others.

"His loss is a poignant reminder of the enormous sacrifice that our armed forces and their families make in the service of our country."

Major Wilks, described by the MoD as a "proud family man", is survived by his wife and two sons.

He joined the Intelligence Corps in 2012 and was deployed on multiple operational tours, including to Afghanistan.

Major Wilks was the recipient of two operational service medals and a long service and good conduct medal.

His commanding officer praised Major Wilks as "a man of great intellect, yet he remained a mate to those he served with".

They added: "He spoke often of his love for his wife and two sons, expressing his deep gratitude for the support they provided, which allowed him to serve with such distinction.

"It is because of that foundation that he was able to meet the challenges of his role, and it is in the course of his devotion to duty that he made the ultimate sacrifice."

articles.body:
On the eve of training camp practices set to begin tomorrow morning, the Penguins officially announced their 2026 training camp roster .

The Pittsburgh Penguins have invited 69 players to their 2026.27 training camp presented by UPMC, it was announced today by President of Hockey Operations and General Manager Kyle Dubas. The training camp roster, which can be seen here , includes 36 forwards, 23 defensemen, seven goaltenders and three injured players. Training camp opens on Thursday, September 17 at the UPMC Lemieux Sports Complex. All practices at the UPMC Lemieux Sports Complex are free and open to the public. The Penguins' 2026.27 training camp roster includes 28 players who skated in at least one game with Pittsburgh last season. Sidney Crosby , who is entering his franchise-record 22nd season, and alternate captains Evgeni Malkin and Kris Letang are returning for their 21st season as a trio. As of this season, no athlete in Pittsburgh sports history has played more seasons for a team than the 'Big Three'. The Penguins added plenty of newcomers this season, including free-agent signings Andrei Kuzmenko, Declan Carlile and Trevor van Riemsdyk , as well as trade acquisitions Nick Robertson and Kaedan Korczak. Goaltender Collin Delia will be attending training camp on a Professional Tryout Contract. Coming off the Prospect Tournament last weekend, Pittsburgh's top three picks in the 2026 NHL Draft, Liam Ruck (22nd overall), Marcus Ruck (39th overall) and Tomas Galvas (54th overall), will be attending their first training camp alongside fellow 2026 selection Matvei Nikonovich (160th overall).

articles.title: Flyers Add 11 Players to Roster Ahead of 2026-27 Training Camp
articles.summary: The Philadelphia Flyers have officially added 11 players to the 2026-27 Training Camp. 11 players from the Flyers’ rookie camp […]
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Flyers have officially added 11 players to the 2026-27 Training Camp. 11 players from the Flyers' rookie camp are joining the already existing 46-man training camp roster . The roster now sits at 57 players.

Forwards Brady Berard, Alex Ciernik, Matther Gard, Owen McGloughlin, Ilya Pautov, Nathan Quinn, and KJ Sauer are all joining camp. Defensemen Brek Liske and Luke Vlooswyk, and goalies Martin Phsohlavec and Marek Sklenicka are all joining the main camp from rookie camp.

They join forwards Porter Martone, Jett Luchanko, Noah Powell, Devin Kaplan and Cole Knuble, as well as defensemen Jackson Edward, Ty Murchison, Oliver Bonk, and Maksim Sokolovskii, and goalie Carson Bjarnason, who are also coming to main camp from rookie camp.

Berard was signed by the team before training camp, making him the only non-draft pick to get the call from rookie camp to main camp. KJ Sauer, the Flyers' high school draft pick from the 2026 NHL Draft, joins Alex Bump , Noah Cates , and Nick Seeler as players at Flyers' camp drafted out of high school.

Training camp kicked off at 8:45 AM this morning at the Flyers Training Center in Voorhees, New Jersey.

articles.title: Recently-cut Panthers WR reportedly signing with new team
articles.summary: WR Jimmy Horn Jr., who was waived by the Panthers on Tuesday, is reportedly expected to sign with the Browns.
articles.body:
The story between the Carolina Panthers and wideout Jimmy Horn Jr. seems to be over.

According to league insider Jordan Schultz, the Cleveland Browns are expected to sign Horn. The second-year receiver was waived byt the Panthers on Tuesday to make room on their active roster for veteran inside linebacker Tyrel Dodson .

Horn's departure came after the season-opening loss to the Chicago Bears on Sunday, where he muffed his very first punt return on the afternoon. But according to head coach Dave Canales, it was the numbers game that caught up to Horn.

"Yeah, the roster spot drove it," Canales told reporters on Wednesday. "But certainly for Jimmy, and we had a great conversation—he and I and Dan [Morgan] talked about it. Wanted to make sure he understood that we see the progress that he's making, we see the strides."

Canales added that he and the team had hoped to get Horn back in the building.

"We want him to come back. We want him to be here on the practice squad, because he brings a lot to what we can do.

"And this isn't the end of that story. This is just a part of it. And right now, we have to make the best decisions, I have to those hard decisions along with Dan to make sure we get guys out there that we feel confident with."

Going into Week 2, the Panthers may feel confident in fellow pass catcher John Metchie III — who has been elevated as the primary kick and punt returner on the depth chart in place of Horn.

The Panthers will face the Browns in Week 3.
